verdict.rationale: Workable documents a broad REST API covering jobs, candidates (create, list, rate), members (invite), departments (merge), requisitions, stages, offers, permission sets and events. It also has an official MCP server described as providing 'full programmatic access' across the hiring lifecycle. However, no source explicitly claims API parity with the UI. Several UI features have no API evidence, and some API areas appear read-only, such as stages defined on the recruiting preferences page and offers. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement; API coverage for UI features like the careers page builder, custom report builder, multi-board job posting, translation and AI sourcing; write access for stages and offers; a published OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s); independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
Invites a member. Required scope: w_members. Accessible with all token types.
